name: Xirl
description: Xirl was a jungle planet located in the Xirl system in Wild Space, near the Kalidorn system. The Stinker was a creature that was native to Xirl. The female human Gozetta built a hunting lodge on Xirl. The planet was a source of messages piggy-backing on official channels, calling on people to resist the Galactic Empire.
